segments.segment_text: a. Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa. Rain-wind/ thunderstorm (isolated heavy falls/ hailstorm) is expected in Dir, Chitral, Swat, Kohistan, Shangla, Battagram, Mansehra, Abbottabad, Haripur, Buner, Malakand, Bajaur, Mohmand, Kohat, Peshawar, Charsadda, Nowshera, Mardan, Swabi, Khyber, Orakzai, Kurram, Hangu, Lakki Marwat, Karak, Bannu, D.I Khan and Waziristan from 10th (evening/ night) to 14th November 2026 (morning) with occasional gaps. Snow over the mountains may also occur during the period.

b. Punjab/ Islamabad. Light Rain-wind/ thunderstorm is expected in Islamabad, Potohar region, Mianwali, Khushab, Bhakkar, Sargodha Murree and surroundings tonight. More Rain-wind/ thunderstorm is expected in Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Murree, Galliyat, Attock, Chakwal, Jhelum, Mandi Bahauddin, Gujrat, Gujranwala, Hafizabad, Wazirabad, Lahore, Kasur, Sheikhupura, Sialkot, Narowal Mianwali, Khushab and Sargodha on 12th and 13th November 2026 with occasional gaps. Rain wind/ thunderstorm is also expected in Dera Ghazi Khan, Layyah, Bhakkar and Multan on 12th November 2026. Isolated hailstorm may also occur during the period.

c. Kashmir/ Gilgit-Baltistan. Rain-wind/ thunderstorm (snow over the hills) is expected in Kashmir (Neelum valley, Muzaffarabad, Rawalakot, Poonch, Hattian, Bagh, Haveli, Sudhanoti, Kotli, Bhimber and Mirpur) and Gilgit-Baltistan (Diamir, Astore, Ghizer, Skardu, Hunza, Gilgit, Ghanche and Shigar) from 10th to 14th November 2026 (afternoon) with occasional gaps.
